_comment: Maps a FIDE profile ID (the Chief Organizer's ratings.fide.com/profile/<id> id, as shown on a tournament's tournament_information.phtml page) to that organizer's club/series website. Two rules, learned the hard way: (1) the URL must be a stable page that lists tournaments — not a homepage that redirects to whatever single event is current, and not a page that renders empty; (2) only add an entry when the organizer's actual events here match the club. A FIDE 'Chief Organizer' is a person, and people direct events for several different organizations, so a city or venue match is NOT evidence — verify against the real event names. When an organizer's events span multiple orgs, or the organizing body is ambiguous, leave them out entirely: the site falls back to the FIDE event page, which is always correct if sparse.

2059487._note: Grant Oen is CCC's Senior Events Manager; all his events here are CCC-branded

30930189._note: chessclub.org is also official but renders an empty page; milibrary.org/chess is the real content

2071320.name: Wisconsin Chess Association
2071320._note: the WCA sponsors the William Martz Memorial / North Central Open

39989917.name: Day & Knight Chess Club
39989917._note: his event is the 'Day and Knight Open' — the club name is in the event title

30990025._note: his events are the 'Poison Pawns' series at the Houston Chess Studio

30938694.name: Texas Chess Association
30938694._note: the Southwest Open is hosted by the TCA

2036380.name: Reno Chess Club
2036380._note: Jerry Weikel runs the Reno Western States Open, his only event here. Deliberately the WSO sub-page rather than a listing page: the club root never mentions the WSO at all, and renochess.org doesn't surface it either, so neither lets a visitor actually find this tournament.

2057638.name: MACA (Massachusetts Chess Association)
2057638._note: MACA organizes the New England Open. The only http:// entry here — masschess.org serves no HTTPS, so an https URL fails to connect. Fine for an outbound link; don't 'fix' it to https.

3204308._note: Thai Ly's events are MCC-prefixed (MCC Classic, MCC Bob Brooking, MCC Greg Hjorth) plus the Victorian Chess Championship, which MCC's own events page also lists as one of its hosted tournaments

3202046.name: Sydney Academy of Chess
3202046._note: Brett Tindall's events are the 'Burwood Saturday Rapid' series, run at Sydney Academy of Chess's Burwood premises

3201414.name: Hobsons Bay Chess Club
3201414._note: Steven Hogan's events are all Hobsons Bay-prefixed club tournaments

3266150.name: Hobsons Bay Chess Club
3266150._note: Kuanysh Batyrbekov's event is the Hobsons Bay Koshnitsky Rookies and Juniors Cup — same club as 3201414, different committee member submitting to FIDE

3206440.name: Perth Chess Club
3206440._note: Robert Maris's events are the Wolfgang Leonhardt Cup and John Brooke Cup, both confirmed as Perth Chess Club's own annual cups

3210995.name: Norths Chess Club
3210995._note: Stephen Garner's events are the Norths Winter Classic and Norths Seniors, both Norths-prefixed

3273709.name: Darling Downs Open
3273709._note: Both of this organizer's rows (Premier/Major Division) are sections of the same single annual Toowoomba tournament, which has its own dedicated site

3251098.name: Hobsons Bay Chess Club
3251098._note: Casey Goh's events look like Chess Victoria state events, but Hobsons Bay hosts them and its own portal lists every one: Best in the West (Aug 29-30), Victorian Women Championship (Sep 12-19), Victorian Junior Rapid+Blitz (Oct 3-4) all match our dates exactly

3205762.name: Chess Artists Caulfield Chess Club
3205762._note: the 'Chess Artists Winter Open' is this club's own event; site carries a 'Calendar Summary of This Years Events'

3235084.name: South Australian Chess Association
3235084._note: SACA runs the South Australian Rapid Championship at its Chess Centre. Like the Oregon entry, sachess.org.au answers automated checks with a challenge page (202/empty body) but loads fine in a real browser — don't 'fix' this to a different URL on that basis.

3258181.name: South Australian Chess Association
3258181._note: SACA is the confirmed organizer of the City of Adelaide Championship (Tuesdays, Jul 14 - Sep 8 2026, The Chess Centre) — same site caveat as 3235084

3236528.name: Chess Association of Queensland
3236528._note: the actual organizer (Qld Womens Chess League) has no site of its own, but CAQ's calendar lists this exact event — '2026 Christmas Special', 2026-12-12, Grace Lutheran College Rothwell — matching our row on name, date and venue

9100075.name: ACT Chess Association
9100075._note: Shaun Press runs two unrelated series. ACTCA's front page carries the ANU Open under FUTURE EVENTS but never mentions Street Chess; streetchess.net covers only the weekly Street Chess. Hence the split — see resolve_organizer().

3230015.name: Perth Chess League (CAWA)
3230015._note: CAWA's page names Ian McAteer as Perth Chess League Coordinator and its round dates match ours (R4 27 Aug, R6 19 Oct, R7 10 Nov; R5 has since moved). His one non-PCL event is the SSCC David Ellis Cup, which the SSCC tournaments page lists by name. NOTE: the CAWA URL is year-stamped — it will need bumping to 2027perthchessleague.html; there is no year-agnostic equivalent (perthchessleague.html 404s).
